name: Shader background (mesh / grain / warp / swirl)
retention: A moving, on-palette backdrop makes a product card or end card feel produced, not a flat slide, without pulling the eye off the words on it.
example: Halcyon Cold Brew. Steeped 18 hours. Order yours today.
credit: Shaders adapted from Paper Shaders (Apache-2.0) packages/shaders/src@71be015; looks from Remocn (MIT) registry/remocn/shader-*@7aebcbe; modified
notes: Opaque: it replaces the picture for its span (a cutaway), so put text or a product cut-out above it on a higher track. Pass the brand palette in `colors`. Render cost MEASURED (scout, 2026-10-24, SwiftShader): grain-orb 12-15 s per output second at 1080x1920; mesh/warp/swirl 1.5-2 s per output second at 540x960 (roughly 4x that at full size). Keep clips short (2-4 s) or prefer mesh-*.
